visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The frame opens with a static shot of a bright, modern bathroom countertop. On the white surface, a silver chrome faucet is positioned next to a black pump bottle labeled 'Miller Harris TEA TONIQUE,' a white electronic grooming device, and a blue container of 'SUCCESS' hair gel. The background consists of white tiled walls under bright, even lighting. (2) A human hand enters the frame from the right and picks up a dark gray and silver electric shaver from the counter. The camera provides a close-up view of the shaver's blade head, highlighting its metallic texture and ergonomic design. The lighting reflects off the silver components of the device. (3) The same hand reaches back toward the counter and picks up a black plastic comb guide attachment. The camera tracks the hand's movement as it brings the attachment toward the main body of the shaver. Other toiletries on the counter remain static in the background. (4) An Asian man in his late 30s with short, neatly styled black hair is shown in a medium shot, looking into a bathroom mirror. He is wearing a black long-sleeved shirt. He uses his fingers to touch and adjust the hair around his sideburns and temples, inspecting his reflection carefully. (5) In a tight close-up, the man's hands are shown attaching the black plastic comb guide to the top of the electric shaver. The attachment is pressed firmly into place until it is securely fastened. The man's fingers move with precision and purpose against the gray body of the tool. (6) The man holds the shaver up to his right temple and begins to trim his hair. He moves the device in short, controlled downward strokes around his ear. Small fragments of black hair are seen falling from the side of his head as the blades work. (7) A close-up shot reveals the white sink basin covered in numerous small, trimmed black hair clippings. The scattered hair contrast sharply against the clean white ceramic surface. The faucet is partially visible in the blurred background, maintaining the setting's consistency. (8) The camera cuts back to the man as he trims the hair on the left side of his head. He uses a similar technique, guiding the shaver carefully around the curve of his ear. His facial expression is concentrated and serious as he watches his movements in the mirror. (9) After finishing the trimming, the man puts down the shaver and examines his hairlines on both sides. He smiles subtly at his reflection and nods in approval, displaying satisfaction with his grooming. The final shot captures his clean-cut appearance in the bright bathroom light.

The video uses a tutorial format to show a middle-aged man achieving professional grooming results in a domestic setting, appealing to men looking for convenient self-care solutions.
